layout.hierarchy: Title dominates first (largest, red, bold). The three graph panels are the visual core (equal size, equal weight). Red captions are secondary. Bottom definition box is body-text level. Slide-number badge is smallest.

visual_elements.description: Panel 1 'Monotonically Increase': 2D line plot. Red L-shaped axes; y-axis labeled 'O/P' (label at top of axis), x-axis labeled 'I/P' (label at right end below axis). No numeric ticks. Single blue curve starts near origin (low), rises steeply in an S-shape, plateaus flat at ~60% height across the middle-right, then rises steeply again ending near top-right (~90% height). A green dashed vertical arrow points UP at ~30% x, mid-height; a green dashed horizontal arrow points RIGHT at ~55% x near the bottom.

Panel 2 'Monotonically Decrease': identical red axes with 'O/P' top and 'I/P' right, no ticks. Single blue curve starts near top-left (~90% height), descends steeply, plateaus flat at ~50% height across the middle, then descends steeply to bottom-right (~10% height). A green dashed vertical arrow points DOWN at ~25% x, mid-height; a green dashed horizontal arrow points RIGHT at ~50% x near the bottom.

Panel 3 'Not Monotonic': identical red axes with 'O/P' top and 'I/P' right, no ticks. Single blue curve starts top-left (~90% height), descends steeply to a rounded valley (~20% height at ~40% x), rises to a rounded peak (~70% height at ~65% x), then descends steeply to bottom-right (~15% height). Three green dashed vertical arrows: DOWN at ~20% x, UP at ~55% x, DOWN at ~85% x; plus two green dashed horizontal RIGHT arrows near the bottom (~30% x and ~55% x). Two thin vertical tan/light-orange guide lines run the full panel height at ~45% x and ~72% x.

Bottom definition box: thin red rectangular border, cream fill, two left-aligned text lines: 'For Monotonically increase function:  When Input increases → Output increases' and 'For Monotonically decrease function:  When Input increases → Output decreases' (words increase/increases/decrease/decreases rendered bold).
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle with thin dark outline containing the number '22' in dark text.
Decorative frame: thin dark-maroon rectangular border running around the entire gray slide canvas, inset slightly from the slide edges.
All in-panel arrows are dashed green: vertical up/down arrows indicating output direction, horizontal right arrows indicating input direction.
visual_elements.position: inside each of the three graph panels

visual_elements.description: Mouse-cursor icon: small white arrow pointer (screen-recording artifact) floating between panels 1 and 2, just below the panels.

typography_notes: Title 'Monotonic Functions' is large bold sans-serif, red, sentence case. Panel captions ('Monotonically Increase', etc.) are bold sans-serif, red, slightly smaller than title, each broken across two centered lines. Axis labels 'O/P' and 'I/P' are small bold red sans-serif. Bottom definition text is serif (Times New Roman-like), black, regular weight, with the keywords increase/increases/decrease/decreases in bold; the ** markers in the transcribed bullets denote this bold rendering. Slide number '22' is small dark text in a yellow circle. No italics, no all-caps, no numbered bullets anywhere.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built: all three panels, all captions, and both definition lines are visible simultaneously. No mid-build reveal. The visible mouse cursor suggests this frame was captured during live narration, not during an animation transition.
